steps.code:
# Parse the note content and update TODO entries with release month
import re

note_content = note['content']
lines = note_content.split('\n')

# Build mapping from song title to release month (MM/YYYY)
song_release_map = {}
for detail in song_details:
    title = detail['title']
    # Extract month and year from release_date (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS)
    release_date = detail['release_date']
    # Parse date
    from datetime import datetime
    dt = datetime.strptime(release_date, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
    month_year = f"{dt.month:02d}/{dt.year}"
    song_release_map[title] = month_year

# Process each line
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        match = re.match(r'^- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO$', line)
        if match:
            title = match.group(1).strip()
            artists_str = match.group(2).strip()
            # Get release month from map
            if title in song_release_map:
                month_year = song_release_map[title]
                # Replace TODO with month_year
                new_line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {month_year}')
                new_lines.append(new_line)
            else:
                print(f"Warning: No release date found for {title}")
                new_lines.append(line)
        else:
            print(f"Could not parse line: {line}")
            new_lines.append(line)
    else:
        new_lines.append(line)

new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)
